summary:
Echoes of Exploration is an interactive educational website that tells the stories of NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Through mission cards, a visual timeline, and links to NASA resources, the project explores the purpose, achievements, and lasting scientific contributions of historic spacecraft and exploration hardware.

The website introduces young space enthusiasts to missions such as Apollo, Surveyor, Viking, Spirit, Opportunity, and Ingenuity. It explains that even when a mission ends, the discoveries and engineering achievements of its equipment remain valuable.

Our goal is to make planetary exploration accessible and engaging while encouraging curiosity about space science, engineering, and future exploration.
details:
What the project does

Echoes of Exploration is an interactive educational website developed to tell the stories of NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. It presents selected missions through individual artifact cards, a Moon/Mars filtering feature, and a chronological timeline.

Visitors can explore the purpose of each mission, understand what its equipment accomplished, and follow links to NASA's original mission information.

Benefits and intended impact

The project aims to make space exploration easier to understand, especially for school-age students and people interested in science and engineering. It highlights how scientific discoveries and engineering achievements continue to matter even after spacecraft become inactive.

Tools and technologies

The website was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. GitHub was used for source-code hosting, and GitHub Pages was used to publish the website publicly. NASA's Space Science Data Coordinated Archive (NSSDCA) and NASA mission pages were used as research resources.

Creativity and design

The project presents space exploration as a collection of stories rather than simply a list of missions. Its interactive Moon and Mars filters, mission cards, and timeline help visitors explore the history and legacy of these machines in an accessible way.

ChatGPT assisted with drafting explanatory text and generating the initial HTML, CSS, and JavaScript structure. The project content and code have been reviewed and should be checked by the team before final submission.
